purpose: User explicitly requested forum screening lessons; bounded two author posts and one counterexample reply. Actual receipt clocks in raw_capture_receipts.json prevail.

sources.author: 以运为名
sources.adopt: Microcap abrupt-pull clues require minute/seat evidence; cycle-node context can be independently causal input.
sources.reject: Region/industry alone establishes fund identity; later board outcomes are first-close predictors; author-selected cases establish predictive accuracy.

sources.author: 安心猿
sources.adopt: Prioritize microcap/low-turnover risk review, require multiple evidence channels, preserve strong-sector and restructuring alternative explanations. Existing project turnover<5% policy defines a conservative screen, not new identity truth.
sources.reject: Claim100% reaches3/4boards; unverified named cases/seat lists as fund labels or blacklist; permanent industry/region veto; buying first board automatically avoids risk.
sources.conflict: The same post recommends avoiding the pattern and then asserts deterministic early-board profits; deterministic claim rejected.

sources.use: Limited counterargument: a shrinking one-price sequence may also have restructuring explanation. Not an actual restructuring fact or a historical exception label.

capital_definition: Source-specific historical outstanding shares times unadjusted close, yuan, float capital proxy. Total capital/free float/strict original asof not certified. Never replace with current cap.
threeboard_constraint_implementation: Dated actual risk evidence may veto; when unavailable identity remains UNKNOWN. A separate conservative microcap-and-thin-turnover operational screen is evaluated with all discarded winners retained, never advertised as identifying the actual funds.
